## Checklist
- [ ] No safety rule in SAFETY.md is weakened (spoken yes before sending, no deleting, no message text in logs, untrusted text can't trigger actions).
- [ ] No cloud service, API key, account, telemetry or paid dependency.
- [ ] New downloads are pinned with a SHA-256 (requirements.lock / setup/models.json).
- [ ] Tests pass, and no real personal data (messages, numbers, names, recordings, logs) is included.
